message.text:
Since there's no Go toolchain available, I'll need to do textual counting manually instead. My plan is to gather all declared function and method names in the internal package, then count occurrences of each name followed by an opening parenthesis across all .go files in the repo, excluding the declaration line itself, and note separately whether calls come from tests versus production code.

I should be careful since method names might collide across different types, which could inflate counts for the finalists. Let me start with the bulk count first.

value.diffString:
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/fanin.sh
@@ -1,0 +1,17 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# For each function/method declared under internal/, count call-like occurrences repo-wide.
+cd /bench/repo
+
+# collect declared names: package-level funcs and methods
+grep -rhn --include='*.go' -E '^func ' internal \
+ | sed -E 's/^[0-9]+:func \([^)]*\) /func /' \
+ | sed -E 's/^[0-9]+:func /func /' \
+ | sed -E 's/^func ([A-Za-z0-9_]+).*/\1/' \
+ | sort -u > /tmp/names.txt
+
+while read -r n; do
+  [ -z "$n" ] && continue
+  # count call sites (exclude declaration lines)
+  total=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "[^A-Za-z0-9_.]${n}\(|\.${n}\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:func ' | wc -l)
+  echo -e "${total}\t${n}"
+done < /tmp/names.txt | sort -rn | head -40

+#!/bin/bash
+# Usage: callers.sh SYMBOL
+# Prints: enclosing-function<TAB>file for each call site, then summary counts.
+cd /bench/repo
+sym="$1"
+files=$(grep -rl --include='*.go' -E "[^A-Za-z0-9_.]${sym}\(|\.${sym}\(" .)
+for f in $files; do
+  awk -v sym="$sym" -v file="$f" '
+    /^func /{
+      fn=$0
+      sub(/^func \([^)]*\) /,"",fn)
+      sub(/^func /,"",fn)
+      sub(/[(\[].*/,"",fn)
+      cur=fn
+    }
+    {
+      line=$0
+      if (line ~ ("^func ")) next
+      if (line ~ ("[^A-Za-z0-9_.]" sym "\\(") || line ~ ("\\." sym "\\(")) {
+        print cur "\t" file
+      }
+    }
+  ' "$f"
+done | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
